subject: Kickoff coordination: POC success criteria, timeline & owners
messages:
From: Sara Khan <sara.khan@acme-corp.com>
To: luke.meyer@redwood.inference.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff — aligning owners and success targets

Hi Lukas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the execs liked the latency/cost numbers. Wed like to get a formal POC kickoff on the calendar so we can align success criteria and stakeholders (engineering, security, procurement). High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm who from Redwood will own the SE + runtime demo (we need an SE and a technical owner).
- Draft success criteria (latency SLO, throughput targets, data handling notes).
- Timeline: two-week hands-on POC with milestone check-ins.

Can you propose 2x 60-minute slots next week? Idll loop in our procurement/security once we settle a time.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Khan
Head of Platform Engineering
Acme Corporation

From: lukas_meyer@redwood.inference.com
To: Sara Khan <sara.khan@acme-corp.com>
Cc: ava.chen@redwood.inference.com, diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — aligning owners and success targets

Sara, thanks — glad the numbers resonated.

Proposed 60-minute windows (all PT):
- Tue, Oct 27 10:30 - 11:30
- Wed, Oct 28 14:00 - 15:00

Attendees from our side:
- Lukas Meyer (AE) — overall program owner
- Ava Chen (SE) — technical walkthrough + runtime owner
- Diego Fernandez (Solutions Eng) — deployment and infra checklist

Ill attach a short kickoff agenda and a prep checklist for your infra team. If either slot works, tell me and Ill send a calendar invite and a short agenda that includes success criteria we can iterate on.

Also, if youre planning to include procurement/security in the first meeting, we can compress the agenda: 30 minutes for technical + 30 minutes for procurement/security Q&A.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Email: luke.meyer@redwood.inference.com
Phone: (415) 555-0134

Attachments: POC-Agenda-v1.docx (attachment), PrepChecklist.xlsx (attachment)

From: ava.chen@redwood.inference.com
To: Sara Khan <sara.khan@acme-corp.com>, lukas.meyer@redwood.inference.com
Cc: diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — aligning owners and success targets

Sara, quick note from the SE side with a draft 60-minute agenda (we can tighten):

1) 5 min — Introductions & scope (Lukas)
2) 15 min — Architecture & network/firewall checklist (Ava)
3) 20 min — Live demo: inference flow, quantization/throughput knobs (Ava + Diego)
4) 10 min — Security & data handling (we'll surface SOC2 evidence)
5) 10 min — Success criteria & timeline (mutual action plan)

Owners: Ava = tech lead, Diego = deploy runbook, Lukas = overall PM for the POC.

For SOC2 items we can share a redacted summary during the meeting and follow up with SOC2-summary.pdf for procurement. If you want procurement to approve a contract term in this meeting, we should reserve the final 10 minutes for next steps only.

Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Sara Khan <sara.khan@acme-corp.com>
To: lukas.meyer@redwood.inference.com, ava.chen@redwood.inference.com
Cc: Luis Ramirez <luis.ramirez@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — aligning owners and success targets

Thanks both. Luis (procurement) is ccd; hell need the SOC2 summary and a short statement on retention/DB handling.

We have a conflict the week of Oct 27 in our security calendar; can we move to Mon, Nov 1 or Tue, Nov 2? Prefer mornings PT. Also please include a short mutual action plan (milestones for weeks 1 and 2) in the invite so our PM can sign off before the call.

Sara
